name: AND, OR and NOT as contacts: a tank's fill valve and horn

tags.comment: a switch: TRUE while the tank is in Auto

tags.name: TankFull

tags.name: FillValve

rungs.comment: AND with NOT: the fill valve opens while Auto is on AND the tank is NOT full. Two contacts in series; the second is normally closed.
OR: the horn sounds if the tank is full OR Test is pressed. Two contacts side by side, in parallel.
